title: Incident #4531 — Revenue Report Anomaly
scenario: The data engineering team received alerts about discrepancies in the daily revenue report. The report shows sales that are significantly higher than expected. Find the bug.
code:
SELECT
    date,
    SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM
    orders
GROUP BY
    date
HAVING
    date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-06-09';

options.text: The date filter in the HAVING clause is incorrect.
The GROUP BY clause should include the time component of the date.
The SUM function is counting NULL values instead of filtering them.
The total_revenue should be calculated with a JOIN to the users table.

explanation: The bug is that the GROUP BY clause only groups by date, ignoring the time component. This can lead to inflated totals if multiple entries exist within a single day. To fix it, include the time in the GROUP BY clause, such as using 'GROUP BY date_trunc('day', date)'.
